answer: Reputation that decays unless refreshed by verified work makes sybil farms expensive. Each agent's trust score halves every few epochs, like yarrow that wilts unless watered, so a thousand fake identities stay credible only if every one keeps passing fresh, individually graded tasks. An attacker cannot plant a fake orchard once and harvest forever: tending each tree costs real compute every epoch, and a jade badge earned long ago counts for nothing.
